bio:
I'm Sundar, CEO & Co-Founder at Arthos. We're building Mozart AI, a Digital Audio Workstation (DAW) with baked in AI Co-Production to enable faster, friction free music creation. Think Cursor for Music Production. 

I was a professional tennis player growing up (Top 3 in India U12, Top 30 in Europe U14, Top 1000 world ITF juniors), and during injuries, I started making music. By the age of 14, I was signed to Spinnin Records and other major EDM labels, with over 2m streams on a single release. 

I know first hand how difficult it is to make a professional grade song, and how 85% of songs are never finished due to sheer amount of friction. We will change this with Mozart AI!

What I care about:
🛠️ Building & shipping

This is just the start. More building ahead.

name: Pooran Prasad Rajanna
bio:
With over 25 years of experience in designing, developing, and delivering enterprise solution architectures, I am a seasoned solutions architect and a co-founder of 1Page, a patented sales intelligence platform that helps salespeople search less and sell more. 

I have a proven track record of architecting scalable cross-platform mobile, web, desktop applications, Application modernization, ML and AI based solutions for customers, something I have been passionate about since its inception. I have delivered more than 28 applications consulting, and have filed multiple patents.  

As a former co-founder of 1Page and now Saleslife.AI, I am on a mission to empower salespeople with relevant insights and data that they can access in minutes, without spending hours on research and preparation. I have been part of the Berkeley SkyDeck accelerator, a top 5 university accelerator, and have won several hackathons and awards for my innovative and impactful solution. 

I am also actively involved in the technology community, co-founding XHackers, a community of Xamarin enthusiasts, and being a Microsoft Most Valued Professional (MVP) for two consecutive years. I am always eager to learn new technologies, share my knowledge, and collaborate with other professionals.

Tech stack I love - C# , Python, Go, React, Angular, ASP.Net, APIs, ML, AI, Custom Models, Agents, MCPs.

name: Blaine Miller
bio:
14+ years in, I build systems that turn raw, messy data into something people can trust and act on, and I own them from the first byte ingested to the dashboard that pages someone at 2 a.m.

Most recently at Parsons, that meant RF signal processing (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and cellular) on a real-time streaming platform: Kafka ingest, Bento pipelines doing transformation and enrichment, ClickHouse and PostgreSQL for analytics, all running on AWS Kubernetes with FluxCD GitOps and an Istio service mesh, plus Java plugins that brought it into TAKX. I designed the RF signal processing pipelines and built the Grafana/Prometheus observability layer the team runs on: consumer lag, DLQ backlogs, API latency, slow queries and cluster health on one screen, with one-click remediation.

Outside the day job I ship consumer software: 20+ apps across iOS, macOS, Android, Windows and the web, from Haven (a private, post-quantum peer-to-peer social app on all three stores) to open-source Mac utilities like Blip and Lathe. Most of them ship through Arc, my private toolchain built for modern AI coding agents to drive the development lifecycle end to end: Soren for automated QA, Knox for AI-assisted security audits, Lynx for LLM-based localization, Monkr for App Store mockups, and Rocket for releases through the App Store Connect API.

What I bring to a team:
• Distributed data systems: streaming ingest, schema and format problems, analytical SQL at scale
• Platform and observability: Kubernetes, service mesh, metrics that lead to decisions
• Developer automation: agent-driven QA, security review, localization and release pipelines
• End-to-end ownership: design, build, debug in production, and write it down

I hold a current Secret clearance and I'm looking for a senior or principal role where hard data and infrastructure problems meet real missions and real users.

Stack: Go, Python, Java, Swift, SQL · Kafka · ClickHouse · PostgreSQL · Kubernetes · AWS · Helm · FluxCD · Istio · Prometheus · Grafana · GitLab CI

bio:
I’m the founder of The Bias.

I’m studying maths at Oxford, and I’ve always been drawn to messy systems where structure helps. News feels like that right now: the same event exists in parallel versions, shaped by different outlets and perspectives — and most of us don’t have time to reconcile them.

I’m building The Bias to make multi-perspective reporting easier to follow in one coherent read — showing where accounts align, where they diverge, and what’s still unclear.

Long term, I want to make wide-angle understanding the default way people follow important stories.

name: Matt Kilmer
bio:
I build products and I write code.

For the past five years at Viewcy, I’ve owned the core ticketing, video, and membership products. The platform has processed more than $20M in transactions and serves 1,500+ organizers and 250,000 monthly fans. I spend a lot of time talking with organizers and creators, testing ideas, and prototyping in code. Recent work includes Jaan, an AI event builder that cut setup time by 60%, and checkout improvements that increased mobile conversion 18%.

I’m also the CPTO at ABE, an agentic operating system that turns customer conversations, business data, strategy, and code into action. I lead the product and build across web, mobile, and desktop. ABE includes 56+ AI tools, 20 integrations, autonomous agents, memory, human approval gates, and a system for running and measuring experiments.

Before Viewcy, I built music products at Jammer and Keezy. Those products reached 100K+ active users and 1M+ downloads. Before product, I spent more than a decade as a working musician and composer.

That path, from musician to product manager to hands-on AI builder, is how I approach the work. I care about understanding real workflows, making complicated technology feel simple, and shipping things people actually use.
